description: A test file using Vitest framework for testing payload-related helper functions in the interactive payload module of a project. It verifies functions that handle reply channel data, reply content, payload content, and interactive reply normalization.

methods.name: hasReplyChannelData
methods.description: Checks if the provided value contains reply channel data with non-empty slack block data.

methods.name: hasReplyContent
methods.description: Determines if the reply content object contains meaningful content, ignoring whitespace and empty structures.

methods.name: hasReplyPayloadContent
methods.description: Checks if the reply payload contains text or channel data, considering options for explicit channel data or extra content.

methods.name: normalizeInteractiveReply
methods.description: Normalizes the interactive reply blocks into a consistent format.

methods.name: resolveInteractiveTextFallback
methods.description: Resolves the text fallback for interactive replies, concatenating text blocks.
